title: Instance-dependent sequential limits as an exact information ledger
abstract: arXiv:2610.42133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Instance-dependent limits for bandit regret, sequential tests, best-arm identification and Markov decision processes are proved by one chain. It runs from a divergence decomposition through data processing to a statistic, a testing step that turns a class guarantee into a requirement on the history, and optimization over alternatives and allocations. Only the first step is an identity. This work writes the chain as an exact ledger. By the chain rule, data processing loses exactly a conditional divergence, which vanishes for arms in natural exponential families at the per-arm counts and reward sums. A one-parameter family of martingale identities extends the decomposition to every tilt between two instances. The classical limits follow by relaxations with named defects. translated_title: 作为精确信息账本的实例相关序列极限
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2610.42133v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：多臂老虎机遗憾、序贯检验、最优臂识别和马尔可夫决策过程的实例相关极限通过一条链路得到证明。该链路从散度分解出发，经过数据处理到达一个统计量，再经过一个将类别保证转化为对历史记录要求的检验步骤，最后在备选实例和采样分配上进行优化。其中只有第一步是恒等式。本工作将这条链路写成一个精确的账本。根据链式法则，数据处理恰好损失一个条件散度，而对于自然指数族中的臂，在每臂计数和奖励总和处该条件散度恰好为零。一个单参数的鞅恒等式族将该分解扩展到两个实例之间的任意倾斜。经典极限通过对带有明确命名缺陷的松弛得到。除渐近步骤的缺陷外，所有缺陷都可以从算法自身的运行中计算出来，而一致量化的缺陷仅当类别保证是一个数值时才能计算。在七个已发……
tldr: 本文将多臂老虎机、序贯检验、最优臂识别和马尔可夫决策过程的实例相关下界统一为一条“精确信息账本”式的证明链路——从散度分解经数据处理（恰损失一个在自然指数族下消失的条件散度）到检验与优化，并借助单参数鞅恒等式族推广到实例间的任意倾斜。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies instance-dependent lower bounds for bandit regret, sequential testing, best-arm identification, and MDPs into an exact information ledger — a single chain from divergence decomposition through data processing (losing exactly one conditional divergence that vanishes for natural exponential families) to testing and optimization, extended to all tilts between instances via a one-parameter family of martingale identities.
